build_YOLOV3Head: build a YOLOV3Head detection head with configurable anchor generator, bbox coder, and loss functions
predict_by_feat: predict bounding boxes and class scores from feature maps using the YOLOV3Head forward pass
loss_by_feat: calculate classification, confidence, and coordinate losses for YOLOV3Head training on ground truth instances
get_targets: compute target maps and negative maps for anchors across multiple images and feature levels
responsible_flags: generate responsible anchor flags mapping ground truth boxes to grid cells across multiple scales
